current_detections.name: Head and Shoulders
current_detections.evidence: Three distinct peaks visible with middle peak highest near 561-562, left and right shoulders near 560, neckline support around 555-556. Current price 555.87 testing neckline area.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Confirmed candle close below neckline trigger level (~555) to confirm breakdown.

tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price spiked below 553 around 08:00, sweeping liquidity, then reversed strongly with a large green candle rallying toward 560.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None; pattern is complete.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Two distinct resistance tests near 560-561 with intervening support around 556.5-557.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed break below support/neckline

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price action shows converging lower highs and higher lows within the 552-562 range, forming a contracting volatility pattern with multiple touches on both boundaries.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Directional breakout with volume confirmation from either the upper or lower trendline boundary.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish breakdown below 555 to bullish reversal, with price reclaiming the 555 level and approaching the 560-562.5 swing high.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above 562.5 to confirm bullish CHoCH; failure to hold above 555 would invalidate

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp rally from approximately 552 to 558 followed by tight consolidation drifting slightly lower between 555 and 558
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Decisive break above flag resistance at 558 with supporting volume

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bullish higher highs to bearish lower highs; price broke below recent swing low area around 556-558.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained bearish follow-through and confirmed market structure shift.

tracked_patterns.name: Bearish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp decline from approximately 562 to 555 followed by slight consolidation near current levels.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear parallel flag channel formation; decisive break below flag support.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Bottom
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price formed a swing low near 555-556, rallied to approximately 558-560, and is currently retesting the prior low area around 556-557, suggesting a potential double bottom structure.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Requires a decisive close above the intermediate peak/neckline around 559-560 to confirm bullish reversal.

tracked_patterns.name: Ascending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Series of higher lows from 552.5 toward 557-558 with horizontal resistance at 560-561
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above 561 with sustained close

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish structure weakened after failure at 562 high and decline toward previous swing low area.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close below swing low to confirm structural shift from bullish to bearish.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (Bearish)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish structure with higher highs and higher lows from the 552.5 swing low. Price is now breaking below the most recent higher low around 557.5.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Close below 557.5 to confirm the structural break and shift to bearish order flow.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Three distinct peaks visible with middle peak highest near 561-562, left and right shoulders near 560, neckline support around 555-556. Current price 555.87 testing neckline area.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed candle close below neckline trigger level (~555) to confirm breakdown.

tracked_patterns.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Three distinct lows visible with the middle low lower than the left and right shoulders. Price is currently testing neckline resistance around 560.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above neckline at 560 to confirm pattern completion.

tracked_patterns.name: Triple Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Multiple distinct peaks testing the 560-562 resistance zone with repeated rejections.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed breakdown below neckline support near 555.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after the low near 552.5; price is now challenging previous swing highs
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close above previous swing high at approximately 561.5

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shows higher highs and higher lows since the 05:00 low, with price approaching a break above the most recent swing high.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed close above 562.5 to validate bullish BOS.

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Engulfing
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent strong bullish candle near current price area appears to engulf the body of the prior bearish candle.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation of the 15m candle close to validate the engulfing relationship.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish higher-high structure failing at resistance, price approaching recent higher low support.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close below structural swing low to confirm bearish BOS

tracked_patterns.name: Falling Wedge
tracked_patterns.evidence: Since the peak near 562, price has been forming lower highs and lower lows within a contracting range.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakout above upper trendline or breakdown below lower trendline boundary.

tracked_patterns.name: Descending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Series of lower highs near 562, 561, and 560 with price repeatedly testing support around 556-557.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear horizontal support confirmation and decisive break below support level.

tracked_patterns.name: Doji
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent candles near current price show small bodies with wicks on both sides, indicating market indecision at the 556 level.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Next candle close to confirm directional follow-through (bullish or bearish).

tracked_patterns.name: BOS Bearish
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent lower low formed below prior swing structure around 556-557, indicating bearish structure break.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close confirmation below broken structure level.
